queries.query: Analyze the overall architecture of the HelloWorldApp.

The project includes a namespace called 'HelloWorldApp.Utilities', which contains a class named 'Helper'. The project does not have any external dependencies, indicating it is self-contained. The 'WorkerFactory' class includes a method named 'CreateWorkers' and does not inherit from any class or implement any interface. The 'WorkerA', 'WorkerB', and 'WorkerC' classes each contain a constructor and a 'Process' method, and all implement the 'IWorker' interface. The 'Manager' class includes 'Run' and 'Notify' methods and implements the 'INotifier' interface. The 'TestAliases' class contains a 'TestMethod' and does not inherit from any class or implement any interface. The 'Program' class contains the 'Main' method, serving as the entry point of the application, and similarly does not inherit from any class or implement any interface.
